messages.subject: *** Warning *** Numerical error gives b22
parts:
Hello INLA users,

I'm fitting a model with poisson likelihood, one covariate and a besag effect. When I fit it, the next warning message appears repeatedly:

*** Warning *** Numerical error gives b22 = -0.091456 <= 0.0 for idx=54015. setting b22=1.49167e-154

After, I get some results that seems to make sense, however I don't know what it means and how can I solve that.

Thank so much!

Best wishes.
Joaquín.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] *** Warning *** Numerical error gives b22
parts:
This is due to close to singular matrix. The math says that b22 > 0,
but the numerical value is < 0. you can try to make the model less
singular
